query: Why was the cash top-up to my / my loved one's Special or Retirement Account refunded or partially refunded?
reference_answer: Your top-up was refunded as you / your loved one had received other inflows at the same time as the cash top-up was made. These inflows had resulted in you / your loved one to meet the current Full Retirement Sum or Enhanced Retirement Sum (for members age 55 or above).
context:

answer: The refund was likely due to receiving other inflows that met your Full Retirement Sum (FRS), as per Document 1. Additionally, if your account hasn't been created, you could top up to your Special Account (SA). Cash top-ups to SA are eligible for tax grants under the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme (MRSS), but tax relief doesn't apply if it's a transfer. [Document 1]
